title: What kind of country (identity carousel)
hook: people ask what kind of country i play.
body:
grew up on waylon and merle. baritone, neo-traditional, that 90s sound. i just try to write true ones and sing em like i mean it.

san antonio based, out on the road most weekends. texas music's a welcoming place. feels like a brotherhood.

glad you're here.
media_notes: Lead slide uses a real press portrait; add more photos as extra carousel slides.
visual_headline: what kind of country i play
notes: Now uses Ben's real framing from his bio (San Antonio, 'musical brotherhood'). No blank left.
